title: 3rd hearing in Mehmet Yıldız's case
paragraphs: The third hearing has been held against East Post correspondent Mehmet Yıldız on charges of terror organization propaganda.
According to the indictment, Mehmet Yildiz reported police violence in custody published on June 2, 2025. The verdict was carried out: Anti-Terror Law 7/2 (terror organization propaganda).
The trial was held in front of Diyarbakır 9th Heavy Penal Court on January 22, 2026. The court postponed the trial until April 16, 2026.
Attorney Hakan Demirtaş in the Mehmet Yıldız case stated that his client has been under arrest for 214 days and that detention has exceeded reasonable time.
Mehmet Yildiz works as a reporter at the East Post as a reporter for Diyarbakır. Press occupational organisations have announced that they are closely monitoring the case.
The prosecutor's office will present its original debate at the next hearing. Mehmet Yıldız is under arrest.
